snippet.title: AfterMove - This Minimalist Grid Puzzle Will Melt Your Brain (Free Demo Out Now!)
snippet.description:
AfterMove is my first video game, and the demo just launched on Steam. It's a turn-based tactical puzzle where every piece on the board obeys a fixed rule, and they all move the moment you do. Some step one square. Some charge two. Some cut diagonally. Some leap in L-shapes. Some move opposite to you. Some are walls.

Learn the rules and the board starts to make sense — but with a dozen of them on a 6×6 grid, that doesn't make it easy.

Simple goal: reach the goal square.
Two modes: Casual lets you move one step at a time. Expert makes you commit your full plan upfront before anything moves. Same puzzles, very different feel.

Demo is free — 20 casual + 5 expert levels. Keyboard, mouse, and controller supported.

Download on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4614710/AfterMove/

Made entirely solo. Full game ships later this year. 
Wishlisting helps a lot, real impact for a small launch.

Download from Itch.io
https://colinord.itch.io/aftermove

I'm Colin Ord, author of Magic Moving Images, an animated optical illusion book that sold over 50,000 copies.
